svg.title: The four inventory states and the acts that move between them
svg.desc: A new inventory is a draft. Freezing it, once its classification is clean, cuts a boundary version and makes it frozen; runs can then be launched. A frozen inventory can be reopened as a draft with a reason, or a run can be marked as final, which makes the inventory final. A final designation can be withdrawn with a reason, which makes the inventory frozen again, or the inventory can be published. A published inventory never changes; a correction is a new draft inventory that supersedes it when published in turn.
